normalization.freshness: Exact video metadata and private media/caption aids checked 2026-10-21; cited research and first-party experiment checked the same day. No product outcome or paper result was independently replicated.

claims.proposition: Named coding benchmarks show often similar task success across model-matched harnesses while cost changes materially.
claims.assessment: Arena reports 21 model-harness combinations on two public coding benchmarks.
claims.limits: Sampled task and model combinations do not establish universal harness parity or external-action safety.
claims.temporalScope: Video uploaded October 19, 2026; source and linked pages checked 2026-10-21. Results and product settings may change.

claims.proposition: With tight context, a controlled same-model harness change improved reported coding completion.
claims.assessment: The separate paper reports gains under a fixed tight-window cohort and smaller gains or parity elsewhere.
claims.limits: This supports context-dependent harness value, not all-purpose superiority.
claims.temporalScope: Video uploaded October 19, 2026; source and linked pages checked 2026-10-21. Results and product settings may change.

claims.proposition: The speaker proposes that harness-produced task traces could train future models to internalize procedures.

claims.limits: No public training-inclusion chain, causal attribution or rights basis was established for private user tasks.
claims.temporalScope: Video uploaded October 19, 2026; source and linked pages checked 2026-10-21. Results and product settings may change.

The new Hassabis profile was compared for a specific shared claim; no further typed relation is admitted on thematic overlap alone. Compared the new Orca fleet Reader as a possible target; its three outbound comparisons cover the supported links, and no reciprocal claim of source corroboration is warranted. The newly added LangChain webhook Reader was compared for a distinct source-grounded relationship; no existing typed edge is changed by this candidate.
